01 — The athlete

Built thehard way

I come from Libya, a country that has lived through years of conflict and instability. There is no state salary and no club budget for athletes here.

So I do it all at once: elite training, a university degree in IT, and work. Every medal came from discipline, smart recovery and refusing to quit.

“My goal is to become world champion and put Libyan sport on the map.”
